reading.title: Comparing shoes in a shop
reading.text: Omar asks a shop assistant for shoes without laces. He tries slip-ons first. Nearby, he sees espadrilles with woven rope around the soles and high-tops that cover the ankles. For an office meeting, he compares Oxford shoes with Derby shoes. He also tries loafers. Before buying anything, he walks a few steps to check the fit.

reading.title: Organizing the footwear shelves

reading.title: Packing a sports-shop order
